svg.title: Caryatid: elevation · close-up in context
svg.desc: Elevation of a draped female figure standing in place of a column, carrying an entablature on a basket capital, with a round close-up of her head, hair and capital. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CLOSE-UP · ×5 · FIGURE 2.3 m TALL · CAPITAL AND ENTABLATURE ABOVE
DRAPED FEMALE FIGURE SERVING AS A COLUMN
